summary: This bill directs the Department of Veterans Affairs to establish a three-year pilot program in two locations to provide hyperbaric oxygen therapy to veterans with traumatic brain injury or post-traumatic stress disorder, funded by donations, and requires a GAO report on hyperbaric oxygen therapy research.
